newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela greets Dutch Queen Beatrix on state visit.
newsitem.headline: Mandela greets Dutch Queen Beatrix on state visit.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela on Monday officially welcomed Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands, whose state visit heralds a new and warmer phase in relations between the two countries.
Beatrix, 58, inspected a guard of honour at the Union Buildings in Pretoria before having talks with Mandela, who was to host a state banquet in the evening.
Beatrix, accompanied by her husband Prince Claus, is the first Dutch monarch to visit the former colony with whom ties were frosty during four decades of apartheid.
She will visit poor black townships and open an exhibition of Dutch masters during the four-day visit, after which she and her family will stay on for a holiday.
A Dutch business delegation is travelling with the queen.
